column3: With respect to the Fulop Brooklyn Multifamily Portfolio 2 Mortgage Loan (0.9%), (i) Ruby Hall Event Space LLC, the sole ground floor commercial tenant at the 104 Graham Avenue Mortgaged Property, has a surrender notice in the guaranty of its lease with six months’ written notice after two years of continuous operation and timely rent payment and (ii) The Hot Spot 2, the sole ground floor commercial tenant at the 155 Central Avenue Mortgaged Property, has a surrender notice in the guaranty of its lease with six months’ written notice.
